claims.statement: Military architect and engineer in the service of Cesare Borgia. Travel through Urbino, Pesaro, Rimini, Cesena and Imola.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Passport dated 18 August 1502; maps and notes in his own hand.

timeline.place: Imola, Cesena, Urbino and the Romagna
